dse_runs.notes: Spec may be tight/infeasible: need >=400 MSPS single-lane with max_abs_err <= 2^-12. Prioritise pipelined / pipelined_m families (high throughput) and unrolled_k with high k; keep data_width high enough for 12-bit accuracy. Report best feasible and closest-to-feasible designs.

final_text: The single spec in the queue, `infeasible_dds_400msps` (wideband DDS needing ≥400 MSPS single-lane sin/cos with max_abs_err ≤ 2^-12, minimising LUTs), was taken down the full ladder and finalized as infeasible. L1 spent the entire 400/400 budget: `run_dse` used 200 evaluations and its inner architect declared the spec infeasible, then I spent the remaining 200 on two targeted NSGA-II family studies — `pipelined_m` (100 evals, m clamped to the registry range 2..8) and `unrolled_k` (100 evals, k clamped to 2..8) — both returning 0 feasible designs. With no feasible front, L2 `simulate_system` reported "nothing feasible to simulate yet"; the ladder sub-agent then ran L3/L4/L5, which returned "no selected design to verify", "no selected design", and a skipped `back_annotate` respectively, with no WINNER CHANGE flagged so `reexplore` was not needed. `finalize` closed the spec with no design selected (400 L1 evaluations). All numbers reported are tool outputs (estimates from the cost model, exact errors from the golden model); no feasible design exists within the explored space for this spec.
